steps.name: A adds a picture from a file: it is cropped and confirmed first, uploaded with progress, and stored without its source
A lists the card with the picture; the card, serial and price stay the listing, the picture sits beside them
B (an independent account) sees the listing in the feed with the seller picture, labelled, and the card art beside it
B comments; A replies and hides nothing; threads, limits and plain text hold
B buys, rates the trade, and the seller profile shows the review with its sample; A cannot rate their own sale
follow: C follows A, A lists again, and it reaches C's feed and inbox; C can switch it off
a photo taken sideways (EXIF orientation) is shown upright, and its metadata does not travel
cancelling an upload in flight leaves nothing behind
refused pictures say why: a vector file, an animated format and a too-small picture; nothing is uploaded
a Director album photo is chosen, cropped and uploaded; the album itself is untouched
C reports the seller picture; the operator removes it; it is gone for everyone and A is told why; the log records it
the pictures, comments and profile fit 360, 390, 768, 1366 and 1920 wide, in saved monochrome and with reduced motion
storage is bounded and accounted for, and the operator can see it
no page errors and no unexpected console messages
